validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly confirmed. This is FERC Docket CP19-517-000 (Gulf South Pipeline Company, LLC, formerly LP): a 3.4-mile, 20-inch lateral from a new Black Creek Compressor Station (Forrest County MS, on Gulf South's existing Index 299 system) to Cooperative Energy's Morrow Repower Project (Lamar County MS), certificated by FERC's order of June 18, 2020 (171 FERC P 61,228) and the accompanying EA (2020-04). Read both PDFs in full. Independently, EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects dataset carries the identical project (docket CP19-517, operator 'Gulf South Pipeline', 3.4 mi, 20 in, 200 MMcf/d, $54.4M) across every release 2019-10 through 2026-08, moving Applied -> Construction (first shown 2021-01) -> Completed with Completed Date 2021-12-15 / Year In Service 2021. gem.wiki's own citation list separately names two Gulf South-hosted PDFs for this exact project (application volume + in-service notification at s2.q4cdn.com) -- both currently 403 to both a scripted UA and a browser UA, and the s2.q4cdn.com root itself also 403s, so this reads as a host-wide bot-wall on Boardwalk's Q4-hosted IR document server, not a deletion (no Wayback capture exists either, so I could not independently confirm content, but I did not rely on these -- the FERC + EIA record stands on its own). CLASSIFICATION: correct -- an NGA-jurisdictional interstate lateral built under FERC Part 157 certificate authority with tariffed Firm Transportation/Firm Lateral Service, i.e. transmission, not gathering. DUPLICATE: checked against all 8 other Gulf South/Boardwalk rows in this batch (P2561, P5926, P5932, P5939, P5967, P5968, P5969, P5974, P5975, P5976) -- none share this length/diameter/capacity/cost/docket profile; CP19-517 is unique to this row. ATTRIBUTION caveat: Owner1 'Boardwalk Pipeline Partners' -- Loews Corporation's own investor page (loews.com/overview) lists its pipeline subsidiary as 'Boardwalk Pipelines' (no 'Partners'), reflecting the entity's 2018 go-private rebrand; whether the SEC/legal registrant is still styled 'Boardwalk Pipeline Partners, LP' vs 'Boardwalk Pipelines, LP' I could not confirm from a single IR page, so I staged the recorded name as REFS_ADDED rather than contesting it -- worth a legal-name check next pass. SPEC caveat: SegmentCost estimates range narrowly across documents ($54.0M sheet vs $54.4M EIA vs $54.6M FERC order) -- normal pre-construction-estimate-to-final variance, not a material disagreement (all within ~1%).

Searched for a second independent confirmation of the actual date: SEC EDGAR full-text search for "Lamar County Expansion" (all forms) returned zero hits; general web search turned up no trade-press piece naming the in-service date; oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/3310 exists for this project but is JS-rendered and returned no readable text to curl or the fetch tool. Note also: Cooperative Energy's Morrow plant did not reach FULL combined-cycle commercial operation until March 16, 2023 (power-eng.com) -- this does not contradict the pipeline's Dec-2021 in-service date (the lateral/compressor station could enter service ahead of the plant's full CCGT commissioning, e.g. for simple-cycle or testing gas), but it is a data point worth having on file. Staying at medium tier for StartYear1/StartMonth1 given the single-origin support for the exact date.
